sections.heading: Coffee & Tea Gift Box FAQ
sections.text: Questions Coffee & Tea Gift Box FAQ Can the box hold coffee bags and a mug together? Yes. The layout is set from your item list: paperboard compartments for pouches or tins, and a fitted cavity for a mug or cups. We check it on a 3D mock-up before the sample. Can you make a box for a dallah and finjan cups? Yes. An EVA foam or fitted insert is cut to the pot and the cups so each piece has its own cavity. Send the item sizes or samples. Compartments or a fitted insert? Paperboard compartments suit soft pouches and tins and keep the box paper-based. A fitted or EVA insert suits ceramic and glass items that must not move. What is the minimum order? 100 pcs per custom size. A physical sample takes 3–5 business days and bulk production 12–15 days after sample approval. Do you supply the coffee, tea or cups? No. We make and ship the empty boxes and inserts; contents are packed at your site.

Your box is developed to your specification and approved on a physical sample before bulk production. A coffee and tea gift box turns a range into a set: three bags of beans side by side, a tea tasting selection, or a pot with matching cups held in a fitted insert. Roasters, tea brands, cafés and gift companies order them for holiday sets, subscriptions and corporate gifts; in the Gulf, Arabic coffee sets with a dallah and finjan cups are a popular Ramadan and Eid gift.
